meta.title: Klarwerk AI Advisor
meta.subtitle: Find the technology that fits your needs.
meta.intro: Describe your everyday, your budget or a device you'd like to compare. I answer based on the Klarwerk catalog – without inventing products.
meta.demoNote: Demo assistant in mock mode. No external AI provider is contacted.

welcome.title: Find the technology that fits your needs.
welcome.text: Tell me what you need a device for – I'll find matching products in the catalog and explain why they fit.
welcome.promptTitle: Where would you like to start?
welcome.promptSubtitle: One click is enough. You can refine the question afterwards.
welcome.example: For example: “I study computer science and need a laptop under €1,200.”

starters.studyLaptop: Which laptop best suits my studies?
starters.comparePhones: Compare the best smartphones in your shop.
starters.everydayHeadphones: I'm looking for good everyday headphones.
starters.homeOffice: Which devices are good for a home office?
starters.laptopDifference: What is the difference between two laptops?
starters.value: Which products offer the best value for money?
starters.tablet: Help me find a suitable tablet.

modePrompts.discover: Show me new products for my everyday.
modePrompts.recommend: Recommend a device for my budget.
modePrompts.compare: Compare two products from the catalog.
modePrompts.explain: Explain a technical difference to me.
modePrompts.store: How do shipping and returns work?

composer.hint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
composer.disclaimer: Answers are generated from the demo catalog and may contain errors.

message.errorTitle: The response could not be completed.
message.errorText: The demo stream was interrupted. You can try again.

recommendations.demoNote: Prices and availability from the demo catalog.

suggestions.title: Follow-up questions
suggestions.budget: What would be a cheaper alternative?
suggestions.stock: Which of these are available now?
suggestions.headphones: Show me quiet headphones for the office.

limits.maxLength: Your message is too long. Please shorten it.
limits.rate: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.

empty.title: No conversation yet
empty.text: Start with one of the questions or describe what you're planning.

side.modesText: The mode sharpens the answer. Without a selection I answer freely from the catalog.
side.how1: Describe your everyday, your budget or a device you want to compare.
side.how2: I search only the Klarwerk catalog – no invented products.
side.how3: You get products, reasoning and, if you like, a direct comparison.
side.privacyText: No external AI provider. Answers are generated locally from the demo catalog and are stored only in this session.
side.historyText: Your conversation stays in this tab until you delete it. There is no account and no cloud storage.
